question: Which deity is designated as the presiding power of this mantra?
premises: That deity is the glorious great god.
He is known by the name Dakṣiṇāmūrti.
inference: The presiding deity of the mantra is the glorious great god named Dakṣiṇāmūrti.
plain_english: The deity is the glorious Mahādeva, known as Dakṣiṇāmūrti.
